title: HogQL database schema layout and system tables
answers: Where are HogQL tables and fields defined?
How is access to system tables controlled?
body:
- Building blocks in `database/models.py`: `FieldOrTable` (hidden, description), `DatabaseField` subclasses (`StringDatabaseField`, ...), `Table`, `LazyTable`, `VirtualTable`, `FunctionCallTable`, `TableNode`, `DANGEROUS_NoTeamIdCheckTable`.
- Catalog: `database/database.py:_construct_database_root_node` builds TableNode tree; `ROOT_TABLES__DO_NOT_ADD_ANY_MORE` is frozen; new non-system tables go in `posthog` node under `# Add new tables here`; `"system": SystemTables()` mounts system tables. `build_database_root_node` pickles once, loads via `_CatalogUnpickler`.
- Per-team `Database` removes unentitled/denied system tables (`_compute_system_table_access_decision`, `system_table_denials`, `_unentitled_system_tables`).
- `database/schema/system.py`: most are `PostgresTable` constants (e.g. `batch_export_backfills`, `postgres_table_name="posthog_batchexportbackfill"`); ClickHouse-native ones like `IngestionWarningsTable`; registered in `SystemTables.children`.
- `PostgresTable` (`database/postgres_table.py`) knobs: `access_scope`, `required_feature_on_cloud`, `access_control_id_field`, `retention_field`, `predicates`. `_scoped_system_tables` is process-cached so `access_scope` must be static.
- `database/schema/AGENTS.md` (CLAUDE.md symlink): give every table/field a `description`; `schema/information_schema.py` exposes them live.
says: Where can I find what data I can query?
How do I add a new data table?
What are the special system data tables?
Who can access what data tables?
What columns and fields are available to use?
search: HogQL database schema uses layered building blocks from database/models.py (FieldOrTable, DatabaseField subclasses, Table, LazyTable, VirtualTable, FunctionCallTable, TableNode, DANGEROUS_NoTeamIdCheckTable) to construct and catalog the database. The root table tree is frozen via ROOT_TABLES__DO_NOT_ADD_ANY_MORE in database/database.py:_construct_database_root_node; new non-system tables must go to the posthog node under the "# Add new tables here" marker. System tables (PostgresTable constants or ClickHouse-native like IngestionWarningsTable) are registered in SystemTables.children; per-team access is filtered via _compute_system_table_access_decision to remove unentitled or denied tables. PostgresTable configuration includes access_scope (must be static due to process caching in _scoped_system_tables), required_feature_on_cloud, access_control_id_field, retention_field, and predicates. Every table and field must have a description attribute for exposure via schema/information_schema.py and documentation in schema/AGENTS.md.
